configuration.repetition_unit: Independent episode. Held-out snapshots average inside a checkpoint; moving primary outcomes average checkpoints inside the episode.
configuration.selection: Independent held-out measured disturbance power on disjoint validation episodes only; no true signature, covariance, oracle power or drift enters policy selection. Static beta=1. Moving mean/mode/isotropic share a mode-selected beta. Modal loading and loaded covariance select their own memory/loading. Sliding GREAT selects window/step/inner count; EW GREAT matches the shared Bingham beta and selects step/inner count.
configuration.great_ew_weights: Complex EW GREAT receives sqrt(eta_j/eta_initial)*u_j, eta_j=tau2_j/[sigma2_j*(sigma2_j+tau2_j)]. Its covariance matches the uncentered Bingham statistic up to the fixed positive factor eta_initial under the uniform prior. Fixed-variance data are unchanged; raw sliding-window GREAT retains the original residual objective.
configuration.variance_convention: Proper-complex covariance sigma2*I; real/imaginary component variances sigma2/2. Unit steering signatures give total interference power tau2.
configuration.motion: Identity transport for all primary unknown-motion comparisons. Baseline half-power desired/interference overlap is held exactly fixed across dimensions.
configuration.numerical_scope: Native complex rank-one means and normalizers only; no higher-rank, tail, interval or second-moment accuracy is inferred from these mean flags.
configuration.scale_information: This performance cohort conditions on the generating variances at correction/action time as a calibrated reference. The separate causal variance-learning cohort never receives future generating scales.
configuration.block_budget: Supplementary cadence/constant-state-block experiment uses 64 independent test episodes per motion at n=32,T=64. Primary stationary/moving performance cohorts retain 256. This smaller block cohort was selected from operation counts/native-mean preflight before any block task outcomes.
configuration.precision: Paper plan: 64 validation and 256 independent test episodes per primary cohort; all paired pointwise 95% intervals and achieved SEs retained. Broad grids are exploratory without multiplicity correction.
